title: PowerPoint on Mac: reference an attached deck's style when creating a presentation with Copilot Agent Mode
notes: claim 50: severity major on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the briefing says the required licence tier is unpublished, but Microsoft's service description identifies editing with Copilot in PowerPoint as a Premium capability requiring a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence. Microsoft also now calls Agent Mode editing with Copilot. The roadmap facts, attachment instructions and licence-assignment controls are supported.
